answer: Every claim climbs the wander of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the wharf re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the whisper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, rewards vest against future work.
